Working with **film-crew** (plan), then **seedance-25-director** (final prompts).

**Session notes:** this folder isn't a git repository and has no `NOTES.md`, so I couldn't pull or check for open items. I didn't change any files, so there's no session entry to push.

## Plan
- **Concept: "From page to screen."** A pen writes the script, the stack of scripts grows, the slate claps, the set rolls, a wall of edit monitors shows the finished work, and the signature ends it. Each shot is one step from writing to full production.
- **Look:** high-contrast black-and-white commercial style. Each shot has exactly one red #D90429 object. Average shot length is about 5 s, so 30 s ÷ 5 s gives 6 shots.
- **How it's generated:**
  - **Unit A** makes shots 1–5 in one 25 s Omni Reference call with hard cuts. One call keeps the light and grade the same across the cuts.
  - **Unit B** makes shot 6 in a 5 s First and Last Frames call. Its last frame is your real logo file (`.claude/skills/director-desk/assets/maghakian_logo_light.png`: white signature, red triangle, transparent background). That way the clip ends on the exact logo instead of handwriting the model made up.
- **Assumptions:**
  - The numbers (48 / 2,300+) and the text are added as overlays in the edit. Seedance doesn't render readable text reliably.
  - Generation has sound effects only. Music is added in the edit.
  - Settings: 720p, English prompts.

## Shot plan
| # | Time | Size / move | Picture | Red accent | Overlay in the edit |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0–4 s | Macro close-up, static | Fountain pen writes on white paper | Red ink triangle | — |
| 2 | 4–9 s | Low angle, slow dolly-in | Tall stack of bound scripts | Bookmark ribbon | **2,300+ episodes** |
| 3 | 9–14 s | Medium close-up, small push-in | Clapperboard snaps shut | Tape on the clapper arm | **Screenwriting →** |
| 4 | 14–20 s | Wide, lateral track left to right | Dark film set, silhouetted crew | Camera tally light | **→ Full production** |
| 5 | 20–25 s | Pull-back to wide | Wall of 48 edit monitors | One monitor | **48 projects** |
| 6 | 25–30 s | Locked camera | White line writes the signature, red triangle lands as the i dot | Logo triangle | maghakianscripts.com (small, under the logo) |

**Editing tasks (separate from generation):**
- Text: white, clean sans-serif. Keep it inside the Reels safe zone, clear of the top 15% and the bottom 25%.
- Music: one low pulse rising to a hit on the clap at 9 s, then silence under the logo except the pen sound.
- Cut 25 s→26 s: hard cut from the monitor wall to black.

## Risks
- **Shot 6 may garble the letters in the middle of the write-on.** The last frame will still be correct. If the middle looks bad, skip generating it and do a mask-reveal of the real logo PNG in CapCut (about 4 s). That method can't fail.
- **Text may appear on the slate or monitors anyway.** The prompt bans it. If it still shows, regenerate or blur it in the edit.
- **Unit A may soften a hard cut into a morph.** If that happens, split Unit A into two calls: shots 1–2 (9 s) and shots 3–5 (16 s).

---

## FINAL

### Unit A: shots 1–5
**Settings:**
- Dreamina mode: Seedance 2.5, Omni Reference
- Duration: 25 s
- Ratio: 9:16
- Resolution: 720p
- Uploads: none

```text
Asset declaration: no uploaded references; text-only generation.

Summary: a 25-second vertical monochrome brand teaser in five hard cuts, from a fountain pen writing a script to a film set to an editing room; a world of pure black, white and graphite, high-contrast, with exactly one small red (#D90429) object in each shot.

[0-4s] Shot 1. Extreme close-up, macro lens, 45-degree top-down angle, camera static. A black fountain pen nib glides across bright white paper on a graphite desk, leaving a fast handwritten line of black ink with no legible letters; beside the line sits one small solid red ink triangle (#D90429). The nib finishes the stroke and stops next to the red triangle. Hard single key light from frame-left, deep black falloff on the right. Sound: close, crisp nib scratching paper, then silence.
➖ no readable words, no full hand, no colour except the red triangle.

[4-9s] Shot 2. Hard cut. Low angle, slow steady dolly-in along a tall stack of thick bound scripts on the same graphite desk: black covers, white page edges, the stack rising out of the top of the frame. One red ribbon bookmark (#D90429) hangs from the middle of the stack. The dolly ends with the red ribbon centred in frame, then holds. Same hard key light from frame-left. Sound: dry paper rustle, quiet room tone.
➖ no titles or text on the covers.

[9-14s] Shot 3. Hard cut. Medium close-up in a black studio void. A black film clapperboard with blank white stripes and a single strip of red tape (#D90429) on the clapper arm fills the centre of the frame; the arm snaps shut toward the lens, then the camera makes a slight push-in and the slate holds still. Narrow white top light. Sound: one sharp wooden clap with a short studio reverb tail.
➖ no chalk writing, no numbers on the slate.

[14-20s] Shot 4. Hard cut. Wide shot, slow lateral track from left to right across a dark film set: four crew members in black clothing seen only as silhouettes around a cinema camera on a dolly; one white light on a stand backlights a thin haze. The only colour is a small glowing red tally light (#D90429) on the camera body. The track ends with the camera and dolly centred in frame. Sound: dolly wheels on floor track, low electrical hum of the light, distant indistinct crew murmur with no clear words.
➖ no faces visible, no colour except the tally light.

[20-25s] Shot 5. Hard cut. Starts on a single monitor in close-up, then a slow steady pull-back reveals a wall of 48 monitors in a dark editing room, arranged in a tight grid. Each monitor shows a different black-and-white film frame (a face in shadow, a street at night, an empty room, a window). One monitor in the centre glows solid red (#D90429). A silhouetted editor sits in front of the wall, back to camera. The pull-back ends on a wide frame with the monitor wall filling the frame. Sound: low electronic hum, a few soft keyboard clicks.
➖ no readable text on any screen.

Global supplement: strictly monochrome palette of black, white and graphite (#111111) with high contrast, crisp blacks and fine film grain; exactly one red (#D90429) object per shot, only the one named above; hard key light consistently from frame-left; vertical 9:16 composition with the subject in the centre third, nothing important in the top 15% or bottom 25% of the frame; hard cuts at 4s, 9s, 14s and 20s, no dissolves or morphs between shots. No readable text, letters, logos or numbers anywhere; no other colours; no close-up faces. Pure video, no subtitles, no background music, no voice-over.
```

### Unit B: shot 6 (logo)
**Before generating:** make two 1080×1920 PNGs.
- **First frame:** solid #000000, nothing else.
- **Last frame:** solid #000000 with `maghakian_logo_light.png` centred, about 800 px wide. Flatten the transparency onto the black background.

**Settings:**
- Dreamina mode: Seedance 2.5, First and Last Frames
- Duration: 5 s
- Ratio: follows the first image (9:16)
- Resolution: 720p
- Uploads: @Image 1 = the black frame (first frame), @Image 2 = the logo plate (last frame)

```text
Asset declaration: @Image 1 is the first frame, a pure black empty frame. @Image 2 is the last frame, the exact handwritten signature logo in white with a small red triangle as the dot of the i and the word "scripts" beneath it, on pure black; reproduce its shape, position and proportions exactly.

Summary: on a pure black background, a single thin white ink line writes the handwritten signature from left to right, a small red triangle drops in as the dot of the i, and the frame settles exactly on @Image 2.

[0-3.5s] Camera locked, no movement. A thin white line appears at the left and travels to the right in one continuous handwritten stroke, tracing exactly the signature shape of @Image 2, stroke by stroke, at an even fast writing speed. Sound: close, crisp pen scratch following the stroke.

[3.5-5s] The small solid red triangle (#D90429) drops from just above, lands as the dot of the i with a tiny settle, and the word "scripts" fades in beneath; the frame holds still, identical to @Image 2. Sound: one soft muted tap as the triangle lands, then silence.

Global supplement: pure black background throughout, white signature line, the red triangle is the only colour; camera fully static; no extra letters, no change to the logo's shape or spacing, no glow, no particles, no 3D extrusion. Pure video, no subtitles, no background music.
```

**Assembly:** Unit A (0–25 s), hard cut, Unit B (25–30 s). Then add the overlays, the music and the end URL as listed in the shot plan.
